purpose: Low, close three-quarter portrait composition based on the user's photo reference; single composite mock-up.
prompt:
Use case: composition redesign. Create ONE new portrait El Unicornio motorcycle card-art mock-up using three supplied references. Image 1 (photograph screenshot of a man with a motorcycle) is ONLY a CAMERA ANGLE, POSE, FRAMING and DEPTH-COMPOSITION reference. Do not copy its person, clothing, watermarks, text, rounded photo border or photographic rendering. Image 2 (the approved diagonal unicorn motorcycle artwork) is the MAIN CHARACTER, clothing, bike and illustrated style reference. Image 3 (the recent straight-on unicorn close-up) is supplemental for the character's front-facing helmet, expression and color details, but DO NOT copy its centered symmetrical camera composition.

PRIMARY REQUEST: Adapt the photographic reference's dramatic low close THREE-QUARTER portrait shot to this pink humanoid unicorn and his black-and-chrome motorcycle in the desert. The motorcycle's round headlight projects forward and fills the LOWER-LEFT foreground. The unicorn's upper body rises diagonally behind it toward the UPPER-RIGHT, face turned back toward the camera. A casually relaxed rider posed astride the bike, rather than a square head-on racing pose. The camera is LOW beside the front of the motorcycle, looking gently upward. Create a clear large near object / farther character / distant landscape separation suitable for parallax.

MATCH THE REFERENCE COMPOSITION closely: vertically framed, asymmetrical, close crop, visually large round headlamp and chrome front forks toward the left; handlebar/grip intruding from the left edge; a partial fuel tank and upper engine lower-middle; the unicorn's head and helmet in the upper-right/upper-middle; his jacketed shoulders and torso angled away, head turned to regard the viewer. One pink hand can rest naturally near a grip and the other rest casually on his butter-yellow trouser thigh, mirroring the reference's relaxed body language. Show waist and a cropped upper thigh, but NO complete bike, NO complete wheel, NO boots or full legs. Front forks and bike continue beyond the bottom edge. Preserve breathing room around his entire single long horn and pink ears, no crop through horn tip. The headlight must not obscure his face or chest emblem. Keep human-shaped limbs and plausible seated rider anatomy.

CHARACTER INVARIANTS: recognizable adult humanoid PINK unicorn with long angular equine face, pale lavender muzzle, ONE pearlescent pastel horn, upright pink ears, short BANDED PASTEL RAINBOW mane peeking out at the rear, dark sunglasses, BLACK OPEN-FACE helmet with silver/chrome trim, fictional reinforced horn port and chin strap. Slightly derpy, guileless and lovable, modest goofy toothy smile—not human, not aggressive, not a serious fashion-model expression. BLACK LEATHER JACKET OPEN over an icy-aqua TURTLENECK with a high sage-mint folded neck and small unicorn-head emblem on chest. Butter-yellow trousers visible at the thigh where framing allows. Pink HUMAN HANDS, not hooves. Preserve identity and costume from the approved artwork.

MOTORCYCLE: chunky black-and-chrome classic road bike, oversized round warm golden headlamp, small amber signals, chrome fork tubes, coherent handlebars and simple readable mechanical construction. Its nearer headlamp and fork assembly are the principal foreground plane. A slightly diagonal orientation like the photo, NOT a centered symmetrical straight-on vehicle and NOT the earlier wide action cornering shot. Keep the character and bike crisp; this is about perspective and pose, not motion blur.

SETTING: Keep the established American Southwest DESERT HIGHWAY world: a straight road stretching away, low red-orange mesas and small distant cacti, broad cobalt/turquoise sky with restrained cream clouds. Because the camera is angled beside the motorcycle, the distant straight road can recede obliquely and be only partly visible. Keep the horizon LOW and background quieter and less detailed than the hero. Warm late-afternoon gold rim lighting on black leather and chrome, warm coral pink unicorn against blue sky. Do not copy the photo's empty cream studio-like sky or grassy location, and do not add the separate foreground corner rock.

STYLE: Rich crisp faceted low-poly collectible-card illustration, angular sculpted planes, saturated jewel colors, dramatic warm gold highlights and deep clean blue shadows, matching image 2. Not photorealism, not generic soft cartoon, not a game screenshot. Full-bleed 2:3 portrait approximately 1024 x 1536. One cohesive composite mock-up only. No typography, logo, watermark, border, rounded corners, stats or captions. Most important: capture the supplied photograph's low camera, asymmetrical close crop and relaxed three-quarter rider pose while keeping this specific unicorn's established outfit and illustrated style.
